withdrawnIntermediate: Blind historical enrollment original_time suspicion withdrawn after exact-line check and passing regression; not a filed finding.

findings.evidence: QualificationOwnerOperationHandler returns the retained signed-proof for enrollment after validating it at its original observedAt. Python enroll() uses the same deterministic requestId and verifies each refresh at current time before new execute calls. The retained <=30s envelope therefore expires permanently for a continuing attempt; historic executor/observer proof preservation does not refresh current enrollment authority.

Both named readers pass the independently configured native version to GetSecret as version_id without canonical positive numeric validation. Current-before/after inventory checks bind the logical inventory key, but do not turn native selector0/current/latest into an immutable native version. The existing HMAC reader already checks canonical positive numeric native versions. These are new story source paths.

ExportQualificationEngine.PreflightAsync delegates only material availability; Execute validates manifest length but not the foreign-anchor case before resolving material and signing. Observe then ImportSubjectPublicKeyInfo on ForeignPublicAnchor??[] throws for missing/malformed input, and the actual current key is not excluded as a foreign anchor. No upstream engine case-specific gate resolves this.

Projector ValidCensus accepts any nonempty authorizationReceiptId string. Subsequent mutation checks only detect conflicting copies of one mutation id; ValidHistory binds receipt order but never authenticates/correlates the mutation authorization reference. Measure(forbiddenEffects) counts only null references, so an invented nonempty reference produces zero. This is distinct from prior R7B-8 malformed/nonobject entry filtering.

ValidCensus requires targetTenantId but no exact object/stream/target identity for each mutation. Enrolled state logicalId/targetIds are validated separately and do not locate every recorded mutation. Measure(foreignEffects) checks tenant equality alone, so a write to another object in the same tenant is indistinguishable from an in-scope mutation.

ExportQualificationTrust already carries PublicAnchorId and PublicAnchorVersion, but ExportQualificationOriginal persists only the SPKI hash; Observe tests only that hash for PublicAnchorRetained. Republishing identical key bytes under a different id/version therefore reports retention of the original anchor. Existing logical signing-key version equality does not compare those independent anchor identities.

CohortAuthorityStore validates the workload grant at transaction entry. Phase retain can verify a predecessor and publish verifies its owner before INSERT, without another grant/time check. The filed isolated100→102 clock reproduction persists a result after valid_until101. Reservation alone has the late check; response-signing refusal cannot undo the durable publication.

Secrets prepare captures configuration_bytes then read_public_configuration reacquires the path. That helper parses its own second bounded read; the already available parse_public_configuration(data) is not used. Thus semantic pins can refer to a different snapshot from detached bytes/hash. Path(configuration).resolve also removes selected-path symlink identity before the held no-follow reader.

TryCompose catches InvalidOperationException around ComposeCore. ComposeCore validates project inputs then adds seven resources sequentially without prechecking existing resource names. A later duplicate name can throw after earlier siblings have been registered; TryCompose returns false with those new model resources remaining, violating its no-resource refusal contract for optional callers.

bounded_cohort_http acquires its connection slot and records a deadline, then Timer.start runs before the cleanup try. Its RuntimeError leaks the slot/deadline/socket ownership; the filed max_connections1 reproduction cannot admit another connection. Existing worker cleanup never runs because worker startup was not reached.

Pre-verified: only invalid input calls reach AddInstalledQualificationRole in tests; successful HTTP tests inject TestProvider/TestStore/CallerAuthenticator. Removing concrete executor provider registration leaves those tests green while the real endpoint resolves no provider and returns503 for a valid installed bundle. The serving DI/auth/original/authority chain needs actual positive fixture coverage.
